messages:
Ana: quick sync — we need concise landing copy for the three modes (Hosted / Dedicated / Private) that maps to launch posts, the webinar narrative, and inbound routing. can we sketch hypotheses and 1-line CTAs? :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Liam: love it. hypotheses first: Hosted = fastest time-to-value, low setup friction. Dedicated = predictable throughput + SLA. Private = compliance & network control.
Kai: agree. also want a single benchmark thread for webinar: show latency & cost per request tradeoffs and a migration checklist. webinar hook: 'Move from experimentation to production: predictable inference at scale.'
Sophie: rough headline options — Hosted: "Get started in minutes with our Hosted API" vs "Ship LLM features fast". Dedicated: "Reserved GPU pools, predictable performance" vs "Predictable throughput, SLA-backed". Private: "Deploy behind your VPC" vs "Air-gapped and enterprise-ready"
Noah: short CTAs to match: Hosted -> "Start free trial"; Dedicated -> "Book capacity consult"; Private -> "Request private demo". keep CTAs 2-3 words for buttons.
Ana: nice. for launch posts we should surface one micro-case per mode: Hosted = prototype to prod in <1 day, Dedicated = consistent 99th pct latency for bursty traffic, Private = compliance with KMS & audit logs. keep phrasing simple.
Liam: wording check — avoid numbers in copy unless from real benchmarks. can say "low-latency at scale" and "SLA-backed throughput".
Sophie: UI microcopy for the tri-panel on the page: panel titles + 1-sentence blurb. I'll draft visuals once we lock lines.
Ana: inbound routing — we need simple form fields to route leads to the right funnel and to tag trial accounts. Noah, can you draft the routing rules?
Noah: yep. proposal: single form, radio choice "Deployment goal" -> Hosted / Dedicated / Private. submit adds hidden utm:mode and routes to corresponding nurture sequence. For Dedicated and Private, auto-create a high-touch lead and assign to AE.
Noah: snippet for GTM / webhook payload (for engineering):
```
{
  "email": "{{email}}",
  "company": "{{company}}",
  "deployment_goal": "Hosted|Dedicated|Private",
  "lead_tier": "auto-calculated",
  "utm_source": "launch_post"
}
```
Liam: that works. also add a checkbox "share benchmark data" to opt into webinar invites.
Sophie: CTA variants for A/B test — primary (button) and secondary (link). e.g. Hosted primary "Start free trial" secondary "See benchmarks". Dedicated primary "Book capacity consult" secondary "Read case study". Private primary "Request private demo" secondary "Compliance FAQ"
Ana: Webinar framing: 30m with 15m live Q&A. title options: "Serving LLMs in production: benchmarks, tradeoffs, and migration playbook" or shorter "Production inference: benchmarks + playbook". which is cleaner?
Kai: prefer the longer for social posts, shorter for landing hero.
Noah: launch posts cadence idea: 3 posts — 1) hero announcement + 1-liners for each mode, 2) deep dive on Dedicated benchmark, 3) webinar invite with migration checklist tease. schedule over 2 weeks.
Ana: routing for inbound posts — make sure post comments funnel people to webinar sign-up. can we add UTM param example?
Noah: yes: ?utm_campaign=tri_mode_launch&utm_medium=social&utm_content=dedicated_post etc.
Sophie: small language request — avoid 'own the model' phrasing. use "control over serving" or "control over inference".
Liam: can marketing ops auto-tag leads coming from paid vs organic? expensive but useful. tag = paid/organic/source.
Ana: good. next steps: Noah will drop final routing snippet and nurture sequences, Sophie will produce hero microcopy + panel blurbs, Liam will write 3 launch post drafts, Kai will own webinar outline. I'll compile and run by content review tomorrow. :rocket:
launch-bot: Reminder — webinar date placeholder 2 weeks from now (TBD).
Sophie: noted. I'll mock hero and panels tonight and post in this thread. :white_check_mark:
Noah: dropped final webhook payload in the workspace doc (link) and will follow up with ops to implement mapping.
Ana: thanks team. meeting-free day but please add comments here if anything blocks.
